answer: Before acting, every agent locks tundra in a bond. Each epoch the knoll signs funding traces, and the summit counts agents whose stake came from one wallet within three hops as a single operator's. That operator's k-th agent must lock 50k² tundra, held for 30 epochs. An honest newcomer locks 50 tundra. An operator fielding 100 agents locks 16,917,500 tundra, capital that rises with every head and cannot be split across clones.
